H6625.name: Pathrusim
H6625.brief: Descendants of Mizraim, son of Ham
H6625.short: Pathrusim, a People from Mizraim, son of Ham, according to <ref="Genesis 10:14">Genesis 10:14</ref>.

H6611G.name: Pethahiah
H6611G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6611G.short: Pethahiah, head of the 19th priestly division in the time of David.

H6611H.name: Pethahiah
H6611H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6611H.brief: Levite who married a foreign woman
H6611H.short: Pethahiah, a Levite who married a foreign woman during the time of Ezra.

H6611J.name: Pethahiah
H6611J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6611J.brief: Levite appointed for the king's matters
H6611J.short: Pethahiah, a Levite appointed to represent the people before the Persian king during the time of Nehemiah.

H6611I.name: Pethahiah
H6611I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6611I.brief: Levite who led the people in confession
H6611I.short: Pethahiah, a Levite who led the people in confession and worship during the time of Nehemiah.

H6602.name: Pethuel
H6602.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6602.short: Pethuel, the father of the prophet Joel, as mentioned in <ref="Jol.1.1">Joel.1.1</ref>.

H6659I.name: Zadok
H6659I.desc: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6659I.brief: Postexilic high priest, descendant of Zadok
H6659I.short: Zadok was a high priest who served in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H6659H.name: Zadok
H6659H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6659H.brief: Father of Jerusha, wife of King Uzziah
H6659H.short: Zadok was the father of Jerusha, who was the wife of King Uzziah (Azariah) of Judah.

H6659G.name: Zadok
H6659G.desc: High Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
H6659G.brief: High priest during the reigns of David and Solomon
H6659G.short: Zadok was a prominent high priest who served during the reigns of King David and King Solomon.

H6659L.name: Zadok
H6659L.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6659L.brief: Israelite leader who sealed Nehemiah's covenant
H6659L.short: Zadok was one of the leaders of Israel who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

H6659M.name: Zadok
H6659M.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6659M.short: Zadok, a priest, was appointed as one of the treasurers by Nehemiah.

H6659K.name: Zadok
H6659K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6659K.brief: Repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall
H6659K.short: Zadok, son of Immer, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall near his house.

H6659J.name: Zadok
H6659J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6659J.brief: Repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall
H6659J.short: Zadok, son of Baana, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's rebuilding project.

H6667I.name: Zedekiah
H6667I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6667I.brief: Son of Jeconiah, king of Judah
H6667I.short: Zedekiah, a son of Jeconiah (also known as Jehoiachin), king of Judah.

H6667G.name: Zedekiah
H6667G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6667G.short: Zedekiah, son of Chenaanah, was a false prophet who opposed Micaiah and encouraged Ahab to attack Ramoth-gilead.

H6667H.name: Zedekiah
H6667H.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6667H.brief: Last king of Judah before the Babylonian exile
H6667H.short: Zedekiah, originally named Mattaniah, was the last king of Judah before the Babylonian exile.

H6667K.name: Zedekiah
H6667K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6667K.brief: False prophet in Babylon during the exile
H6667K.short: Zedekiah, a false prophet among the exiles in Babylon, was denounced by Jeremiah for his lies and immorality.

H6667L.name: Zedekiah
H6667L.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6667L.brief: Official during the reign of King Jehoiakim
H6667L.short: Zedekiah, the son of Hananiah, was an official during the reign of King Jehoiakim of Judah.

H6667J.name: Zedekiah
H6667J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6667J.brief: Priest who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
H6667J.short: Zedekiah, a priest who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah after the exile.

H6649.name: Zibeon
H6649.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6649.brief: Hivite grandfather of Esau's wife Oholibamah
H6649.short: Zibeon, the Hivite grandfather of Esau's wife Oholibamah.

H6644.name: Zibia
H6644.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6644.short: Zibia was a son of Shaharaim, a Benjamite, born to his wife Hodesh in the country of Moab.

H6645.name: Zibiah
H6645.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6645.brief: Mother of King Joash (or 'Jehoash') of Judah from Beersheba
H6645.short: Zibiah, from Beersheba, was the mother of King Joash (or 'Jehoash') of Judah.

H6637.name: Zobebah
H6637.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6637.short: Zobebah was one of the sons of Koz, a descendant of Judah.

H6690.name: Zophah
H6690.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6690.short: Zophah was a son of Hotham (or 'Helem') and a descendant of Asher.

H6691.name: Zophar
H6691.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6691.brief: One of Job's three friends, the Naamathite
H6691.short: Zophar the Naamathite was one of Job's three friends who came to comfort him during his affliction.

H6686.name: Zuar
H6686.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6686.brief: Father of Nethanel, leader of Issachar
H6686.short: Zuar was the father of Nethanel, a leader of the tribe of Issachar during the wilderness wanderings.

H6689G.name: Zuph
H6689G.desc: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
H6689G.brief: Levite ancestor of Samuel the prophet
H6689G.short: Zuph, also called Zophai, was an Ephraimite Levite, an ancestor of Samuel the prophet.

H6698I.name: Zur
H6698I.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H6698I.short: Zur was a son of Abiel and a descendant of Benjamin.

H6698G.name: Zur
H6698G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6698G.short: Zur was a Midianite leader whose daughter was involved with an Israelite, resulting in a plague on Israel.

H6698H.name: Zur
H6698H.desc: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6698H.short: Zur was one of five Midianite kings defeated by Israel during the conquest of Canaan.

H6624.name: Pathros
H6624.short: Pathros was a region in Upper Egypt (southern Egypt) where some Judeans settled after the Babylonian exile.

H6604.name: Pethor
H6604.brief: The hometown of Balaam in Mesopotamia
H6604.short: Pethor was the hometown of Balaam, the prophet hired by Balak to curse Israel, located near the Euphrates River in Mesopotamia.

H6619.name: Pithom
H6619.brief: A store city built by the Israelites in Egypt
H6619.short: Pithom was one of the store cities built by the Israelites during their enslavement in Egypt, along with Rameses.

H6629H.name: Sheep Gate
H6629H.brief: Gate in Jerusalem near the sheep market
H6629H.short: The Sheep Gate was a gate in Jerusalem's wall, likely near the sheep market, that was rebuilt during Nehemiah's time (<ref="Neh. 3:1, 32; 12:39; Jhn.5.2">Neh. 3:1, 32; 12:39; Jhn.5.2</ref>).

H6630.name: Zaanan
H6630.brief: A town mentioned in Micah's prophecy
H6630.short: Zaanan, a town mentioned in Micah's prophecy, possibly located in the Shephelah region of Judah (<ref="Mic. 1:11">Mic. 1:11</ref>).

H6636.name: Zeboiim
H6636.brief: One of the cities of the plain destroyed with Sodom
H6636.short: Zeboiim, one of the cities of the plain, along with Sodom and Gomorrah, that was destroyed by God due to its wickedness (<ref="Gen. 10:19; 14:2, 8; Deut. 29:23; Hos. 11:8">Gen. 10:19; 14:2, 8; Deut. 29:23; Hos. 11:8</ref>).

H6650G.name: Zeboim
H6650G.brief: A town resettled by the people of Judah after the exile
H6650G.short: Zeboim, a town resettled by the people of Judah after the Babylonian exile (<ref="Neh. 11:34">Neh. 11:34</ref>).

H6650H.name: Zeboim Valley
H6650H.brief: A valley mentioned in connection with Saul's military campaigns
H6650H.short: The Valley of Zeboim, a location mentioned in the context of Saul's military campaigns against the Philistines (<ref="1Sam. 13:18">1Sam. 13:18</ref>).

H6657.name: Zedad
H6657.brief: A place on the northern border of the Promised Land
H6657.short: Zedad, a place mentioned as part of the northern border of the Promised Land in both the Mosaic and Ezekiel's descriptions (<ref="Num. 34:8; Ezek. 47:15">Num. 34:8; Ezek. 47:15</ref>).

H6661.name: Ziddim
H6661.short: Ziddim was a fortified city in the territory of Naphtali .

H6678G.name: Zobah
H6678G.brief: An Aramean kingdom, enemy of Israel during David's reign
H6678G.short: Zobah was an Aramean kingdom northeast of Israel, conquered by David and later a source of opposition to Solomon .

H6689H.name: Zuph
H6689H.brief: A land where Saul searched for his father's donkeys
H6689H.short: The land of Zuph was a region in Ephraim where Saul and his servant searched for his father's lost donkeys .
